channel.title: Nicotine Science and Policy
channel.description: Daily digest of views, debates and discussions on nicotine science, policy, regulation and advocacy.

item.title: Doctor’s orders: Offer vapes to smokers as quitting tool
item.description: A JAMA publication should raise the standard of the nicotine debate, not narrow it into alarm. Research on smoking, vaping or smoke-free products needs to be read through the lens of comparison: what happens to people who continue smoking, switch completely, or use products alongside cigarettes. The public health value lies in that distinction. Evidence should clarify the movement away from combustion, not be used to make every nicotine product appear equally harmful. (Published on August 18, 2026bysmokefreesweden.org)

item.title: Age of Sale Law Changes
item.description: Age-of-sale laws are only as strong as their enforcement. Raising legal thresholds may signal action, but youth protection depends on retailers being checked, illegal sellers being challenged and adults still having credible routes away from smoking. A balanced approach should keep underage users out of nicotine markets without making lower-risk products harder for adult smokers to access. The aim should be targeted control, not broad restriction disguised as protection. (Published on August 18, 2026byplanetofthevapes.co.uk)

item.title: Kuwait Tightens Tobacco and Nicotine Rules, Bans Under-21 Sales and Extends Public Smoking Restrictions to Vapes and Heated Tobacco
item.description: Kuwait’s new nicotine rules place vapes and heated tobacco firmly inside the smoking-control framework. That may simplify enforcement, but it also risks flattening important differences between combustible and non-combustible products. Protecting young people and limiting public exposure are legitimate goals, yet regulation should still preserve a clear pathway for adult smokers to move away from cigarettes. Policy becomes stronger when control is matched with a credible understanding of relative risk. (Published on August 18, 2026by2firsts.com)
